utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Ontario' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: No official Ontario city page or CCA program page confirming CCA membership was found this session. Community Choice Aggregators such as Clean Power Alliance operate only in Los Angeles and Ventura counties (per their own materials cited elsewhere this session), not in San Bernardino County, but no direct city-level confirmation of the absence of any CCA program was found either, so this is left null rather than asserted.

county.notes: Ontario is a well-documented San Bernardino County city; also listed under San Bernardino County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Ontario/San Bernardino County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Standard plan and checklist of all requirements, published on the City's website, substantially conforming to the California Solar Permitting Guidebook

required_documents.notes: Per Ontario Municipal Code Section 8-8.03(a),(d)-(e): the Building Department adopts a standard plan and checklist substantially conforming to the CA Solar Permitting Guidebook, made available on the City's website.

value: Only one inspection shall be required and performed by the Building Department for eligible small residential rooftop solar energy systems
The inspection shall be done in a timely manner and should include consolidated inspections
If a system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized

value.notes: The City's own page states 'Contractors and homeowners seeking to pull permits will be able to apply for instantaneous solar plan review approval...via this Symbium portal.'

other_conditions: Energy storage systems must be less than 38.4 kW
Detached single-family residential re-roof permits are also covered by the same platform
